summary: Verified all 4 device-reported bug fixes. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (reopen, task edit, event PATCH/DELETE, regressions). Frontend web preview: end-to-end flow passed — login → Today → FAB → quick-capture → mic button (shows 'needs the installed app' on web, no crash) → capture created task → item-detail modal → edit title + tap date/time picker (no crash) → Save → verified on Today → Mark as done → Show completed → Reopen task → back in Open list. Bottom tab bar shows Today/Memory/(+)/Courses/Settings.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'DateTimePicker is not supported on: web'. Component gracefully no-ops so no crash, but on web the date/time picker cannot be used to change the date. On device (iOS/Android) it works as expected. Reference: frontend/app/item-detail.tsx:146-154

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:11 (View style={{ pointerEvents: 'box-none' }} passed as prop-like via array). Non-blocking.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Reference: frontend/src/theme.ts (shadow helper). Non-blocking.

device_only_notes: Bug #4 (Android tab-bar overlap fix): code uses useSafeAreaInsets bottom in (tabs)/_layout.tsx via `Math.max(insets.bottom, 8)` applied to tabBarStyle height+paddingBottom, and FAB is lifted by same inset. Correct implementation but overlap can only be visually confirmed on a real Android device.

Bug #3 (real microphone recording/transcription): quick-capture uses expo-audio (useAudioRecorder / AudioModule) and POSTs to /api/transcribe. On web it correctly short-circuits with 'Voice recording needs the installed app.' Actual recording+transcription requires an APK build.
action_items: OPTIONAL: consider adding a web-friendly fallback for date/time editing (e.g., a native <input type="datetime-local"> or a JS picker library) so the field can be changed in the web preview. Currently on web tapping the field shows nothing (warning-only). On device this works via @react-native-community/datetimepicker as intended.
OPTIONAL: silence deprecation warnings — migrate `pointerEvents` prop to style, and `shadow*` props to `boxShadow` (native SDK 53+ still accepts shadow* but warns).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: PATCH /api/events/{id} correctly cancels prior reminders and re-schedules when 'start' changes (routers/planner.py:88-101). Good.

Backend: PATCH /api/tasks/{id} status transitions to 'done' cancel pending reminders and transition commitment to completed; reopening to 'open' works but does NOT recreate the reminder (by design — user can edit the due date via the modal to trigger a new one). Acceptable given the modal reopen flow.

Frontend: item-detail modal correctly wires status toggle, delete, save, and pickers. All required testIDs present (detail-title, detail-save, detail-toggle, detail-datetime, detail-close, detail-delete).
Frontend: Today screen exposes task-open-<id>, done-<id>, done-open-<id>, deadline-<id>, class-<id>, toggle-completed as required.
seed_data_creation: Test emails created via dev-login with TEST_ prefix. One task and one event created per test (self-contained; teardown not required for isolated dev users).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI_PROVIDER=openai (live) in backend/.env. dev-login is enabled (ALLOW_INSECURE_DEV=true). Frontend URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_device_bug_fixes.py can be reused. DateTimePicker is warned as unsupported on web — this is expected, do not flag as a crash.
